title: Witch Breaking the Spell
description: A pink-haired witch with white wings ascends a stone staircase entwined with a gnarled green tree. She swings a large purple hammer labeled 'IMPACT' at a glowing yellow burst, surrounded by white doves, while a black raven and pink bird kiss above in a swirling purple and blue cosmic sky filled with zodiac symbols.
prompt: A vibrant fantasy illustration shows a female witch with flowing pink hair and white angel wings wearing black robes, climbing a stone staircase that spirals around a gnarled green mystical tree with a single yellow eye. She powerfully swings a large purple hammer with the word IMPACT on its head, creating a bright yellow starburst explosion and white doves flying outward. Above, a black raven and a pink bird are about to kiss against a swirling cosmic purple and blue sky filled with glowing zodiac symbols and shooting stars, art nouveau style with intricate linework
